description: For x402 sellers: sellercheck every hour for 30 days on one resource, paid once. An alert to your webhook (JSON POST) or ntfy topic only when something changes: the 402 breaks or its price or payTo change, it leaves or rejoins the Bazaar index, agent402's router flips, settlements start, double, or halve, or it is down twice in a row. Returns a public record page to link from your listing. $1. Paid per call in USDC over x402 (Base, or free test USDC on Base Sepolia). An x402-aware MCP client pays automatically: the first call returns the price as an x402 PaymentRequired error, and the retry carries the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]. Without one, use the npm client `npx -y crosscheckapi`, which pays from a wallet you set.

method.description: Optional: the method it is paid with; default tries GET, then POST

network.description: Optional: Base, the only network read today

notify.description: Where alerts go, at least one: webhook (a public https URL) and/or ntfy (an ntfy.sh topic)

resource.description: The full URL of your x402 resource (public http or https)

name: sellerwatch
title: Watch an x402 resource for 30 days
